plan.notes: Source: 'BFA Performing Arts: Theatre - Technical Theatre Option - Suggested Plan of Study 2025-2026 Catalog' (Dempsey College of Liberal and Performing Arts, Department of Performing Arts), official 2025-2026 SAU Undergraduate Catalog. Major name follows the catalog overview ('Theatre-Technical'); the plan header prints 'Theatre - Technical Theatre Option' and the degree requirements header prints 'Technical Theatre Concentration'. 'THEA or THDA Elective' slots are sequenced at 3 credits; music and art electives may also be selected with advisor approval. Semester credit totals match the catalog's printed totals; sequenced total 120 matches the catalog's printed 'Total hours required for major - 120'. Choice slots use the first-listed option's code with choice=true. REPEATS (per SAU 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog): THEA 1000 Production Run Crew (2 semesters), THEA 1100 Voice Studio (6 semesters), THEA 1110 Acting Studio (6 semesters), THEA 1300 Theatre Production Practicum (6 semesters), THEA 3403 Playwriting I and THEA 3413 Acting for the Camera are sequenced per the catalog plans; allow_repeated_courses set 2026-10-01.
